description: This file contains low-level arithmetic functions for big number (BN) operations, including multiplication, addition, squaring, and division of large integers, with conditional compilation for different hardware capabilities.

methods.name: bn_mul_add_words
methods.description: Multiplies and adds words in big number arithmetic, optimized for different hardware capabilities.

methods.name: bn_mul_words
methods.description: Performs multiplication of big number words, optimized for different hardware capabilities.

methods.name: bn_sqr_words
methods.description: Squares big number words, optimized for different hardware capabilities.

methods.name: bn_div_words
methods.description: Divides two words by a divisor, with different implementations depending on hardware support.

methods.name: bn_add_words
methods.description: Adds two big number word arrays, with support for 64-bit or 32-bit architectures.
